groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Keep shared balances and trips organized in one place.
groups.emptyDescription: Groups you create or join will appear here.
groups.settledAutoHide: Settled groups with no activity for more than 15 days are hidden automatically.

newUser.title: Create your first group or add friends
newUser.description: Track a balance directly with a friend, or keep a separate shared balance inside each group. Once you have a friend or a group, you can start adding expenses.

friendReady.title: You're ready to add an expense
friendReady.description: You can already track a direct balance with a friend. Create a group when you want a separate shared balance for a trip, home, or another plan.

groupReady.title: Your group is ready
groupReady.description: Start an expense in your group now. Invite a friend to also track a separate direct balance outside groups.

fullyReady.title: You're ready to split expenses
fullyReady.description: Add an expense with a friend or in one of your groups. Direct friend balances and group balances stay separate.
